title: Students of All Ages
intro: This platform is open to people of all ages. The project welcomes students of all ages into the world of education. We strongly condemn any form of discrimination based on age. Any bias or discrimination based on a person's age is taken seriously and reported so that appropriate action can be taken.
learningMethodsText: Our attention is not only focused on the teaching methodology for each category of students, but also on the learning methods. Experts have observed that students learn differently and it is necessary to choose methodologies that match the diversity of learning methods.
costReductionText: As a non-profit organization, we do everything we can to reduce the cost of your study as much as possible, while recognizing that the association has operating costs to bear.
equalityText: The academy views all students as equal and pays special attention to groups discriminated against in education, such as indigenous people, older adults, girls, women, and low-income students.
participationText: We encourage participation by all in all major project activities, including intergenerational learning to facilitate the reciprocal exchange of knowledge between students of all ages.
